#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Kernel-only OpenCL ECDSA / BIP-340 verify timing on valid, Python-made signatures.

Usage: bench_verify.py <kernel_dir> <label> <out.json>
Builds secp256k1_extended.cl from <kernel_dir> exactly as the GPU backend does,
times the ecdsa_verify and schnorr_verify kernels (median of 11 launches after
3 warmups) over a batch of 65536 entries made from 512 distinct valid
signatures, and refuses to report a time unless every result is "valid".
"""
import hashlib, json, random, statistics, sys, time
import numpy as np
import pyopencl as cl

P = 2**256 - 2**32 - 977
N = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEBAAEDCE6AF48A03BBFD25E8CD0364141
G = (0x79BE667EF9DCBBAC55A06295CE870B07029BFCDB2DCE28D959F2815B16F81798,
     0x483ADA7726A3C4655DA4FBFC0E1108A8FD17B448A68554199C47D08FFB10D4B8)


def jadd(a, b):  # Jacobian + affine, simple (not CT; test data only)
    if a is None: return (b[0], b[1], 1)
    X1, Y1, Z1 = a; x2, y2 = b
    Z1Z1 = Z1 * Z1 % P; U2 = x2 * Z1Z1 % P; S2 = y2 * Z1 * Z1Z1 % P
    H = (U2 - X1) % P; R = (S2 - Y1) % P
    if H == 0:
        return jdbl(a) if R == 0 else None
    HH = H * H % P; HHH = H * HH % P; V = X1 * HH % P
    X3 = (R * R - HHH - 2 * V) % P
    return (X3, (R * (V - X3) - Y1 * HHH) % P, Z1 * H % P)


def jdbl(a):
    X, Y, Z = a
    S = 4 * X * Y * Y % P; M = 3 * X * X % P
    X3 = (M * M - 2 * S) % P
    return (X3, (M * (S - X3) - 8 * Y**4) % P, 2 * Y * Z % P)


def mul(k, pt=G):
    r = None
    for bit in bin(k)[2:]:
        if r is not None: r = jdbl(r)
        if bit == "1": r = jadd(r, pt)
    zi = pow(r[2], -1, P)
    return (r[0] * zi * zi % P, r[1] * zi * zi * zi % P)


def limbs(v): return [(v >> (64 * i)) & (2**64 - 1) for i in range(4)]


def tagged(tag, data):
    t = hashlib.sha256(tag.encode()).digest()
    return hashlib.sha256(t + t + data).digest()


def main():
    kdir, label, outp = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    rng = random.Random(2026)
    M = 512; BATCH = 65536
    msgs, pubs, esigs, xs, ssigs = [], [], [], [], []
    for i in range(M):
        d = rng.randrange(1, N); m = hashlib.sha256(i.to_bytes(4, "big")).digest()
        Q = mul(d); z = int.from_bytes(m, "big") % N
        k = rng.randrange(1, N); r = mul(k)[0] % N; s = pow(k, -1, N) * (z + r * d) % N
        msgs.append(m); pubs.append(Q); esigs.append((r, s))
        # BIP-340
        dd = d if Q[1] % 2 == 0 else N - d
        kk = rng.randrange(1, N); R = mul(kk)
        if R[1] % 2: kk = N - kk
        rx = R[0].to_bytes(32, "big"); px = Q[0].to_bytes(32, "big")
        e = int.from_bytes(tagged("BIP0340/challenge", rx + px + m), "big") % N
        ssigs.append((rx, (kk + e * dd) % N)); xs.append(px)
    idx = [i % M for i in range(BATCH)]
    msg_arr = np.frombuffer(b"".join(msgs[i] for i in idx), dtype=np.uint8).copy()
    # JacobianPoint: x, y, z (4 ulong each), uint infinity, uint pad[7] -> 128 bytes
    jac = np.zeros((BATCH, 16), dtype=np.uint64)
    for j, i in enumerate(idx):
        Q = pubs[i]; jac[j, 0:4] = limbs(Q[0]); jac[j, 4:8] = limbs(Q[1]); jac[j, 8:12] = limbs(1)
    esig = np.array([limbs(esigs[i][0]) + limbs(esigs[i][1]) for i in idx], dtype=np.uint64)
    xs_arr = np.frombuffer(b"".join(xs[i] for i in idx), dtype=np.uint8).copy()
    ss = np.zeros((BATCH, 64), dtype=np.uint8)
    for j, i in enumerate(idx):
        ss[j, 0:32] = np.frombuffer(ssigs[i][0], dtype=np.uint8)
        ss[j, 32:64] = np.array(limbs(ssigs[i][1]), dtype=np.uint64).view(np.uint8)

    ctx = cl.create_some_context(interactive=False); q = cl.CommandQueue(ctx)
    src = open(f"{kdir}/secp256k1_extended.cl").read()
    t0 = time.time()
    prg = cl.Program(ctx, src).build(options=["-cl-std=CL1.2", "-cl-fast-relaxed-math", "-cl-mad-enable", "-I", kdir])
    build_s = time.time() - t0
    mf = cl.mem_flags
    dm = cl.Buffer(ctx, mf.READ_ONLY | mf.COPY_HOST_PTR, hostbuf=msg_arr)
    dj = cl.Buffer(ctx, mf.READ_ONLY | mf.COPY_HOST_PTR, hostbuf=jac)
    de = cl.Buffer(ctx, mf.READ_ONLY | mf.COPY_HOST_PTR, hostbuf=esig)
    dx = cl.Buffer(ctx, mf.READ_ONLY | mf.COPY_HOST_PTR, hostbuf=xs_arr)
    dsb = cl.Buffer(ctx, mf.READ_ONLY | mf.COPY_HOST_PTR, hostbuf=ss)
    res = np.zeros(BATCH, dtype=np.int32); dr = cl.Buffer(ctx, mf.READ_WRITE, res.nbytes)
    out = {"label": label, "kernel_dir": kdir, "batch": BATCH, "distinct_signatures": M,
           "build_seconds": round(build_s, 1), "device": ctx.devices[0].name, "rows": {}}
    for name, args in (("ecdsa_verify", (dm, dj, de, dr)), ("schnorr_verify", (dx, dm, dsb, dr))):
        k = cl.Kernel(prg, name)
        k.set_args(*args, np.uint32(BATCH))
        times = []
        for rep in range(14):
            cl.enqueue_fill_buffer(q, dr, np.int32(0), 0, res.nbytes); q.finish()
            t = time.perf_counter(); cl.enqueue_nd_range_kernel(q, k, (BATCH,), (256,)); q.finish()
            if rep >= 3: times.append((time.perf_counter() - t) * 1e9 / BATCH)
        cl.enqueue_copy(q, res, dr); q.finish()
        acc = int((res == 1).sum())
        out["rows"][name] = {"accepted": acc, "of": BATCH,
                             "ns_per_op_median": statistics.median(times) if acc == BATCH else None,
                             "ns_per_op_runs": times if acc == BATCH else None}
        print(f"{label} {name}: accepted {acc}/{BATCH}, median {statistics.median(times):.2f} ns/op", flush=True)
    json.dump(out, open(outp, "w"), indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
